verdict.rationale: Relay's own docs show banking, spend, and bill pay in one product: up to 20 checking accounts plus high-yield savings, Visa debit/credit cards with spend limits and roles, receipt capture with accounting sync, and bill pay with multi-step approvals and vendor payments. Invoicing with built-in payment collection is also included ('no separate tool needed'). Independent reviews confirm the banking and multi-account side and the Pro plan's billing features, but say little hands-on about the spend and bill-pay modules, and one user notes some external payments still run manually. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the spend-management and bill-pay modules replacing standalone tools.
